_: WHAT SHIPPED. A film rebuilds from this repo, but the answer to 'which cut is live' does
not, so it is recorded here. docs/01 §6.
FILM SEVEN. The primitive is `count` -- a set a child can count, that changes -- and the two
things docs/03 predicted would be embarrassing turned out to have one answer: THE GOLD AND
THE WHITE ARE THE SAME DRAWING. pipeline/gild.py maps luminance through a gold ramp and
keeps the alpha channel exactly, so 'every single one of them turned into an ordinary white
feather' is literally true of the pixels, the goose after the grab cannot read as a second
goose, and film.js can prove both by comparing two PNGs.
IT CONTAINS TWO HUMAN CHARACTERS. Read cast/mother/cast.json and cast/daughter/cast.json
before this is published anywhere. The mother is not a villain and the film does not play
her as one: she kneels and reaches with open hands, there is no bird in anyone's hands and
no plucked goose in any shot, and the colour change IS the event -- as elliptical as the
app's own telling.
THE HOUSE WAS DRAWN TWICE AND WAS BRIEFLY TWO HOUSES. The repaired plate came back with a
pitched thatched roof where the poor one has a flat roof with a parapet; the plate-canon
check scored it 0.70, over the wall, because every other landmark still matched. A still
caught it and it was redrawn (0.89). docs/02 §5.21.
Picture and sound agree at 117.75s.
NOTHING IS PUBLISHED TO YOUTUBE. Publishing is a human action and nothing in this repo
uploads.
